Chapter 1404 - 16: Let Me Give It A Try_2

Chapter 1404: Chapter 16: Let Me Give It a Try_2

To share the illusory world with many Red Dust Immortals?

But the Three-Life Immortal Emperor did so, perhaps knowing that relying solely on himself, he couldn’t explore that illusory world any deeper.

So he opened the main immortal path to cultivate more companions.

At least compared to when the main immortal path was first opened, with only the Three-Life Immortal Emperor alone sealing the illusory world, which was extremely difficult, constantly facing the struggles of the illusory world.

Now, with three Immortal Emperors joining forces to seal it, the illusory world has become relatively docile, struggling only once in a long while.

"Considering the time, it seems we need to reopen the immortal path again."

The Reincarnation Immortal King said suddenly while drinking fine wine.

Every so often, the illusory world rolls and struggles violently, and the aftermath wipes out the five immortal paths opened by the Immortal Kings.

At that time, many Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings need to reopen new immortal paths to approach the illusory world and continue to comprehend and observe.

Reopening new immortal paths is both a bad thing and a good thing.

Approaching the illusory world from a different position and direction allows experiencing the essence of the Origin Dao differently.

"Reopening the immortal path?"

Lin Yuan was not surprised.

In recent centuries, the frequency of shocks in the illusory world has increased, and the Immortal Kings have long been prepared for this.

"This time, with the addition of Tianyuan, we can choose a better position to open the immortal path."

The Wushen Immortal King’s eyes lit up, approaching the illusory world from different positions and angles allows different insights into the fluctuations of the Origin Dao.

The more core the area, the greater the difficulty in opening it.

...

At the end of the immortal path, the illusory world was vast and boundless.

If one came close to observe, they would find that the surface of the illusory world was covered with chains.

It was these chains that completely fixed the illusory world in place.

Preventing it from leaving or dispersing.

At this moment—

Thin ripples suddenly arose inside the illusory world.

The thin ripples quickly grew into a storm, sweeping towards the chains that restrained it.

The chains shook, blocking the illusory storm, but the remaining aftermath spread out in all directions.

Rumbling—

The five immortal paths near the illusory world rapidly collapsed.

Numerous Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings quickly retreated to the main immortal path.

"Is this the struggle of the illusory world?" Lin Yuan also stood on the main immortal path observing.

At this moment, the main immortal path had gathered all the Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings, more than two hundred Red Dust Immortals and fifteen Immortal Kings, gathering in twos and threes.

Lin Yuan naturally stood with the Reincarnation Immortal King, Immortal King Bai Bin, and Wushen Immortal King.

Other Immortal Kings occasionally made eye contact with Lin Yuan, nodding slightly, showing goodwill.

As fellow Immortal Kings from the Great Wilderness Origin World, they would naturally form friendly relations if possible.

A few months later.

The illusory world gradually returned to calm.

The aftermath that swept in all directions also subsided.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

One after another, Immortal Kings, along with numerous Red Dust Immortals, began to act.

Choosing a position and direction to reopen the immortal path towards the illusory world.

Standing on the main immortal path, one could also view the illusory world, but the distance was too far, providing limited help.

Only by opening an extremely close immortal path could one observe and comprehend the illusory world up close, making a significant impact on oneself.

"This time we’ll open the immortal path from here."

The Reincarnation Immortal King observed for a while, then finally spoke.

"This immortal path?"

Immortal King Bai Bin’s expression changed slightly. The immortal path chosen by the Reincarnation Immortal King led towards the core area of the illusory world.

Attempting to open such an immortal path would encounter greater obstacles.

"Reincarnation, are you confident?"

The Wushen Immortal King asked solemnly.

Opening an immortal path also requires knowing one’s limits.

Forcibly choosing to open an immortal path in a core area, if not successful, the time and effort spent before would be completely wasted.

"I have made a breakthrough in my power, and with Tianyuan joining us, we can give it a try."

The Reincarnation Immortal King said.

"Breakthrough in power?"

Immortal King Bai Bin looked at the Reincarnation Immortal King.

The Reincarnation Immortal King was already close to the peak of Immortal Kings, and now another breakthrough in power?

"In that case, let’s give it a try."

Wushen Immortal King nodded.

The immortal path connecting to the core region is extremely difficult to open, but once successful, it would be greatly beneficial to them.

If it’s only adding Lin Yuan, this action might seem rash, as adding a newly ascended Immortal King doesn’t offer much improvement for them.

However, if the Reincarnation Immortal King steps into the peak of Immortal King, then it would be worth a gamble.

"From now on, you will assist me."

The Reincarnation Immortal King’s hair changed from white to black, as a sense of reincarnation began to permeate around him.

Soon, the Reincarnation Immortal King took a step forward and moved swiftly toward the virtual world.

"Let’s go."

Wushen Immortal King saw this and immediately followed.

Immortal King Bai Bin and Lin Yuan also followed in succession.

Next were dozens of Red Dust Immortals.

Rumble rumble.

As the Reincarnation Immortal King continued to approach the virtual world.

A sky-high force of binding and pressure enveloped around.

Immortal King Bai Bin and Wushen Immortal King’s expressions slightly changed.

The dozens of Red Dust Immortals at the back were also affected.

"Shh shh shh~" As they got closer to the virtual world, the force of binding and pressure grew stronger, permeating through layers of space-time, spreading along the timeline, unavoidable and must be endured.

The Reincarnation Immortal King walked at the forefront, resisting the greatest pressure.

As for Immortal King Bai Bin and Wushen Immortal King, they began to stabilize time and space.

Opening the immortal path is about creating an area of stable time and space, within which one can wholly comprehend the virtual world without resisting external environmental pressure.

What Immortal King Bai Bin and Wushen Immortal King are doing is just that, along with the dozens of Red Dust Immortals at the back.

With the Reincarnation Immortal King blocking most of the pressure, others stabilized time and space, opening a stable immortal path.

"Endless reincarnation."

As the Reincarnation Immortal King advanced closer to the virtual world, a reincarnation realm began to evolve around him, continuously converting and dispersing the sky-high binding and pressure.

The appearance of the reincarnation realm allowed the Reincarnation Immortal King to breathe a sigh of relief.

But before long, the Reincarnation Immortal King’s expression changed again.

Because the sky-high force of binding increased suddenly from all directions, causing his reincarnation realm to show signs of collapse.

"Looks like I overestimated myself."

The Reincarnation Immortal King sighed inwardly, halting his steps towards the virtual world.

If he continues, the force of binding will increase, likely causing his reincarnation realm to collapse instantly.

"Reincarnation, what’s the situation?"

Immortal King Bai Bin immediately asked.

"I cannot go any closer."

The Reincarnation Immortal King stated honestly.

Once his reincarnation realm collapses, the few Immortal Kings present and the numerous Red Dust Immortals may immediately face physical annihilation.

Though not complete death, losing their main combat body would be a heavy loss.

"Cannot go any closer?"

Immortal King Bai Bin understood in his heart.

It seems the Reincarnation Immortal King isn’t confident in resisting the pressure ahead.

"Should I share some of the pressure?"

Immortal King Bai Bin said softly, his strength only second to the Reincarnation Immortal King and above Wushen Immortal King.

The opening of the immortal path has already proceeded halfway, giving up now makes Immortal King Bai Bin somewhat reluctant.

"It’s useless."

The Reincarnation Immortal King shook his head.

The aftershocks coming from deep within the virtual world penetrate through various timelines, making the associated future incredibly blurred and distorted.

Before opening this immortal path, the Reincarnation Immortal King couldn’t discern if it could be successfully opened, unclear about the relevant future timelines.

He merely felt a breakthrough in his strength and decided to give it a try.

Now it seems the attempt may have been mistaken.

"Since we can’t go any closer, let’s retreat immediately and choose another path to open."

Wushen Immortal King advised.

"Alright."

The Reincarnation Immortal King nodded.

He glanced at Lin Yuan, who was continuously observing the surroundings, and asked unconsciously: "Tianyuan, do you have any thoughts?"

Those words from the Reincarnation Immortal King were casually spoken, without expecting Lin Yuan to offer anything beyond ’agree’.

"Let me try." Lin Yuan observed the surroundings, having no prior experience in opening an immortal path. He had been watching intently.

Now he somewhat understood and expressed his thoughts.
